goal: Test whether three randomly selected imaginal visual-profile keywords survive candidate-pack composition and one independent built-in image generation call per arm.

reference_boundary.role: visible long dark wavy hairstyle and dark blouse styling reference only

qualification.target_gate_rule: Every profile render gate must pass in the same saved image at its declared review scale.
qualification.concept_gate_rule: The assigned complex scene and practical action must remain readable without substituting for the target profile.
qualification.reference_gate_rule: The output must visibly use the authorized hairstyle or blouse styling while remaining an original adult character; no identity conclusion is scored.
qualification.overall_rule: A missing, partial, ambiguous, environmentally confounded, or substituted target component fails the arm. User aesthetic acceptance remains pending until supplied directly.
